- The Cehotina River is a tributary of the Drina River (which itself is a tributary of the Sava, which flows to the Danube)
- The Pljevlja power plant is the largest thermal power plant in Montenegro
- It's a lignite-fired plant that has been operating since 1982

The operating thermal plant and location within the well-watered Cehotina valley provide strong convergent evidence that cooling water availability is not a constraint.
